summary: Unidentified person found pinned on rocks in the Eagle River ~1/2 mi west of Squaw Creek Road between Edwards and Wolcott; report ~3:45 p.m. Friday; multi-agency recovery response
location: Eagle River west of Squaw Creek Rd, between Edwards and Wolcott
responding_agency: Eagle River Fire Protection District, Vail Mountain Rescue Group, Eagle County Paramedics, Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Identity and gender unknown at publication; body may have been in the river for a while; foul play not ruled out at publication.
